details.name: Name
details.incomplete: Nothing to show: the check did not complete.

errors.bad_flake_dir: The flake directory must be an absolute path without ? or #: {dir}
errors.bad_result: The check finished, but its results could not be read
errors.lock_bad_token: GitHub rejected the token (expired or revoked?). Create a new one or clear the token file setting.
errors.lock_rate_limit: GitHub's API rate limit is reached, so updates could not be checked. The list shows the last known state. It resets within an hour; a token (see the settings) raises the limit.
errors.lock_stale: Could not ask every flake input for its latest revision (no network?). The list shows the last known state.
errors.not_started: Could not start the update check
errors.token_format: The first line of the token file is not a GitHub token. Not used: {path}
errors.token_in_flake: The token file is inside the flake directory, from where Nix could copy it to the world-readable store. Not used: {path}
errors.token_missing: Token file not found: {path}. Checking without a token.
errors.token_mode: Other users could read the token file. Not used until you run chmod 600 on it: {path}
errors.token_owner: The token file belongs to another user. Not used: {path}

panel.no_package_list: Package versions are not compared (turned off in the settings or the evaluation failed).
panel.open_compare: Open the commits between both revisions
panel.title: NixOS Updates
panel.up_to_date: Everything is up to date · checked {time}

check_flatpak.description: List pending updates of system and user Flatpaks (flatpak remote-ls --updates).
check_flatpak.label: Check Flatpaks

check_interval_hours.description: Hours between two checks. Updating flake.lock or a Flatpak installation triggers a check on its own.
check_interval_hours.label: Check interval (hours)

check_packages.description: Evaluate the NixOS configuration with the current and the updated lock and list the package versions that change. This evaluates the code of input revisions you have not accepted yet; nothing is built. Takes a few seconds of CPU per check, longer when a new nixpkgs has to be downloaded.
check_packages.label: Compare package versions

flake_dir.description: Directory with flake.nix and flake.lock, as an absolute path. Not written to; the updated lock goes to the plugin's data directory. Empty: only Flatpaks.
flake_dir.label: Flake directory

github_token_file.label: GitHub token file (optional)
github_token_file.description: Only needed if you reach GitHub's rate limit of 60 requests per hour. Path to a file holding a token without permissions, chmod 600, outside the flake directory. The README shows how to create it. Never paste the token itself here.

hide_when_up_to_date.description: Hide the widget while there is nothing to update and no error.
hide_when_up_to_date.label: Hide when up to date

ignored_inputs.description: Flake input names to leave out of the input list, for example ones you update on your own schedule.
ignored_inputs.label: Ignored inputs

nixos_configuration.description: Name under nixosConfigurations to evaluate. Empty: this machine's hostname.
nixos_configuration.label: NixOS configuration

notify.description: Show a notification when a check finds updates that were not pending before.
notify.label: Notify about new updates

update_command.description: Runs in a terminal from the panel's Update button, for example: nix flake update --flake /etc/nixos && sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake /etc/nixos && flatpak update -y. Empty: no Update button.
update_command.label: Update command
